rules: 战斗背景必须有实际落脚地面。侧视或轻微斜侧视的横向对战构图，主角在左、敌人在右；不绘制任何人物、怪物、血条、文字或UI。
画面约55%～85%高度绘制连续、平整、可行走的宽阔地面。双方脚底基线在约74%高度，左侧约15%～35%宽度、右侧约65%～85%宽度预留完整落脚区域；两个区域由同一条连续地面连接。禁止悬空、悬崖断口、水面或荆棘挡住落脚位置。
输出640×360像素，16:9完整横向战斗场景，画面铺满整个画布，不留边框、空白、透明边缘或嵌套小画面。手机按完整画幅显示，不做居中cover裁切。上方远景低对比，主要战斗地面宽阔平整，前景只占底部少量空间，不遮挡主角24%、敌人76%位置的脚底和身体。血条由游戏在场景外绘制。
荆棘古道示例：平整夯土古道横贯前景，少量嵌平碎石；荆棘、树根、巨石置于两侧边缘或远景，森林纵深在后方。古道不能蜿蜒成仅供俯视探索的狭窄小径。

Complete 640x360 16:9 side-view battle arena. Broad continuous walkable ground at y=55–85%, shared foot baseline near y=74%; clear left landing zone x=15–35%, right x=65–85%. Full-width view, no crop dependency, no isolated edge platforms. No actors, baked UI, text, alignment guides or grid. Keep foreground obstacles below the feet or at extreme edges.

rules: Chinese xianxia pixel UI: dark ink/stone, restrained jade green and small aged-bronze details; coherent hard pixel edges, readable at mobile size.

Only requested standalone UI components. Genuine RGBA PNG: empty margins and gaps are alpha=0, no checkerboard or white showcase background. Intentional panel/button fills and their ornamental borders belong to the component and may be opaque.
Do not bake text, names, numbers, health values, icons, characters, monsters, screenshots or a whole interface into the component.
Each supplied name is one independent static component, not an animation frame. Do not mix families with different sizes in one sheet.

Each panel is ONE complete 96x96 image, not nine separate pictures. Reserve 24px corner bands for nine-slice rendering; the central 48x48 area is calm and tileable. Keep corner ornaments inside the corner bands and side patterns continuous. No drawn slicing lines.

One complete horizontal 192x64 button base per asset; leave the center clear for programmatic text/icons. Reserve corner/end decoration within 24px horizontal and 16px vertical inset bands. Default, pressed or selected variants are separate named assets only when requested; do not invent extra variants.

Button silhouette follows its frame and curved end ornaments. All pixels outside that silhouette, including rectangular corner padding, must be alpha=0. Do not add an opaque rectangular colored underlay behind the ornamental button. Keep the center readable and the ornament restrained for compact mobile controls.

One horizontal 192x32 health track OR fill per asset, according to its name. Track and fill are separate images sharing the same viewport and aligned inner rail. No numbers, percentage text or baked health amount. Keep fill ends simple for programmatic clipping.
One 64x64 compact emblem per asset; simple readable silhouette, no baked words or numbers. Do not draw interface panels or a whole screen.

bar_states.name_zh: 血条 · 六档完整状态 · 192×32
rules: Six independent COMPLETE health bars: empty, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%. These are NOT animation frames and NOT separate tracks/fills. Each named image contains the same frame plus its specified fill.

Lock the exact same 192x32 viewport, outer silhouette, frame, end ornaments, inner rail and placement across all six states. Only change the left-to-right fill length inside the rail to the named percentage; empty means no fill. No percentage numbers or labels baked into PNG. Compact restrained frame, clear fill, transparent pixels outside its silhouette. Never stretch or shift the frame between states.
